title: List open files in a specific directory
summary: Use lsof to see which files within a specific directory are currently open by any process. This helps identify what is accessing files in a particular folder.

aliases.text: what is using files in dir

steps.explain: Run lsof with the +D flag and the directory path to list all open files within that directory.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: The path to the directory to check
